title: The Hook (Sadness vs. Malfunction)
environment: Deep navy blue solid background with a subtle, slowly rising grid.
props: Two line graphs and text headers.
beginning: Left side: Text "SADNESS" appears. A smooth, gently curving line graph dips down and bounces smoothly back to the center.
climax: Right side: Text "DEPRESSION" slams onto the screen. A glowing red line graph plummets aggressively straight down.
ending: The red line hits the bottom boundary, instantly shattering into small fragments that drift outward and fade to 0 opacity.
colors: Text "SADNESS" in white, "DEPRESSION" in neon red (#EF4444). Blue background (#0F172A).

title: The Spectrum of Ten
transition: Quick scale-out from the center of the previous scene.
props: A minimalist brain icon and 10 small circular nodes.
beginning: A grey brain icon pulses in the center of the screen.
climax: The brain violently shakes, and 10 distinctly colored, glowing circular nodes shoot outward from the center, forming a perfect floating ring around the brain.
ending: The nodes pulse independently in a slow breathing animation.
colors: 10 nodes using distinct hex colors (e.g., Cyan #06B6D4, Magenta #D946EF, Amber #F59E0B).

title: The Wrong Drug
transition: The 10 nodes fly off-screen; the central brain remains.
props: Brain icon, a glowing blue capsule pill.
beginning: The blue capsule falls rapidly from the top of the screen toward the calm grey brain.
climax: The pill makes contact. Instantly, the brain's smooth outline morphs into jagged, sharp spikes.
ending: The brain aggressively scales up by 20% and glows a blinding, hostile red.
colors: Pill is clinical blue (#3B82F6). Brain flashes to hostile red (#DC2626).

title: The Manic Break
transition: Hard camera whip-pan to the right.
props: A semi-circle gauge (like a speedometer) and a mechanical needle.
beginning: The needle is resting in a calm, blue "DEPRESSIVE" zone on the left.
climax: The needle violently whips across the gauge to the extreme right, slamming into the red "MANIC" zone with such force that a crack overlay appears on the gauge glass.
ending: The needle jitters aggressively against the maximum limit peg.
colors: Left zone Blue, Right zone Red. Text "MANIC" in bold white.

title: The Brutal Logic
environment: Digital blueprint aesthetic, deep blue background with white grid lines.
props: A large, wireframe blueprint of a human head.
beginning: The wireframe head is drawn instantly using a fast stroke-dashoffset animation.
climax: A bright horizontal laser scanning line moves slowly from the top of the head down to the neck, revealing solid, brightly lit circuitry inside the brain wherever the laser passes.
ending: The laser finishes the scan, leaving the intricate brain circuits fully illuminated.

title: Title - MDD
transition: Sharp zoom-in through the brain circuitry, turning the screen white.
props: Large typography.
beginning: Screen is blank.
climax: Text "1. MAJOR DEPRESSIVE DISORDER" slams onto the screen, word by word, locked to the script audio.
ending: Text holds steady. A flat, dead-black EKG line draws horizontally underneath it.
colors: Text in stark black (#1E293B). Background off-white (#F8FAFC).

title: Neurological Shutdown
environment: Inside a dark outline of a brain.
props: A large industrial electrical switch box labeled "SYSTEM".
beginning: The switch is in the "UP" position, emitting a warm yellow glow illuminating the scene.
climax: An invisible force yanks the heavy lever down to "OFF".
ending: The yellow glow instantly extinguishes, plunging the entire scene into a cold, dark, lifeless grey.

title: Anhedonia
props: Stickman bust (center), three floating icons (pizza, game controller, music note).
beginning: Stickman is blank. The three brightly colored icons bounce playfully in the surrounding space.
climax: A dark grey circle rapidly expands outward from the stickman. As the circle perimeter touches the colored icons, they instantly lose all color, turning flat grey.
ending: The greyed-out icons slowly sink off the bottom of the screen; the stickman remains alone in the dark circle.
colors: Colorful icons (Red, Green, Blue) shift abruptly to Slate Grey (#64748B).

title: Crushing Fatigue
props: A glowing green battery icon, a massive iron weight.
beginning: Battery icon is full and glowing green.
climax: A giant black iron weight drops violently from the top of the screen onto the battery.
ending: The battery is instantly crushed (scaling down on Y-axis). Its charge bar turns red, depletes to 0%, and the green glow dies.

title: Episodic and Acute
transition: The iron weight slides off the bottom of the screen.
props: A continuous line graph.
beginning: A line graph draws a steady, horizontal, normal baseline across the middle of the screen.
climax: Suddenly, without warning, the line takes a violent 90-degree downward turn, plunging straight into a deep trench at the bottom of the frame.
ending: The line flatlines completely at the bottom of the trench.
colors: The line turns from neutral grey to bright red (#DC2626) when it drops.

title: The Two-Week Rule
transition: Sharp zoom-in on the flatlined red graph.
props: A vector desk calendar.
beginning: Calendar displays a clean 30-day grid.
climax: A thick, aggressive red marker rapidly scribbles out 14 consecutive days in a row, using chaotic, zigzagging strokes.
ending: The calendar is ruined by the red ink. A bracket appears below labeling the span "14 DAYS MINIMUM".

title: Title - PDD (Dysthymia)
transition: The calendar falls forward out of frame.
props: Large typography.
beginning: Blank screen.
climax: Text "2. PERSISTENT DEPRESSIVE DISORDER" types out cleanly. Below it, "(DYSTHYMIA)" fades in.
ending: Text holds steady.

title: Hurricane vs. Leaking Pipe
environment: 50/50 vertical split screen (Left: Light Grey, Right: Dark Slate).
props: Thick red bar chart (left), vector water pipe and rising blue block (right).
beginning: Left side bar is at 100%. Right side pipe drops a single teardrop.
climax: Left side (MDD): The red bar violently drops to 10% in a fraction of a second. Right side (Dysthymia): A dark blue block representing water slowly, continuously rises from the bottom of the screen.
ending: The left side remains static and crushed. The right side's dark water continues to slowly fill the frame relentlessly until the scene cuts.
colors: Water block dark blue (#1E3A8A). Left bar red (#DC2626).

title: The Permanent Baseline
transition: The blue water rises completely, transitioning the screen.
props: Stickman sitting at a computer desk, wearing a massive grey stone backpack.
beginning: Stickman is typing at the computer at a steady, slow pace.
climax: The massive stone backpack slightly crushes the office chair (scaling the chair down slightly on the Y-axis).
ending: Stickman continues typing endlessly, carrying the crushing weight as if it is completely normal.

title: The Fake Smile
environment: Close up in the office cubicle.
props: Stickman, a piece of cardboard with a smile painted on it.
beginning: Stickman faces forward, looking completely dead and grey.
climax: He lifts a square piece of cardboard attached to a stick to cover his face. On the cardboard is a crude, brightly painted yellow smiley face.
ending: He holds the fake smile steady, though his grey shoulders remain slumped.

title: Chronicity Over Severity
props: A balanced scale, a massive smooth boulder, a sharp red spike.
beginning: A scale sits perfectly balanced in the center.
climax: A massive grey boulder labeled "CHRONICITY" drops heavily onto the left pan. A small, sharp red spike labeled "SEVERITY" drops onto the right pan.
ending: The scale violently tips down on the left, overwhelmed entirely by the weight of the boulder.

title: The Two Year Sentence
transition: The tipped scale drops off screen.
props: A giant glass hourglass, stickman trapped inside.
beginning: Stickman stands inside the bottom bulb of the empty hourglass.
climax: Dark, heavy sand pours continuously from the top, rapidly piling up around the stickman's legs.
ending: The sand buries him up to the waist. He stops struggling and just stands there as the sand continues to fall.

title: Title - Bipolar Depression
transition: The screen fills entirely with dark sand, then fades to white.
props: Large typography.
beginning: Blank screen.
climax: Text "3. BIPOLAR DEPRESSION" types out quickly.
ending: Text holds steady as a thick black line draws underneath it.

title: The Pendulum
props: A heavy brass pendulum on a long arm.
beginning: Pendulum is hanging perfectly still in the center.
climax: It is suddenly yanked to the far left, then swings violently to the far right, looping continuously with extreme easing (slow at peaks, incredibly fast in the middle).
ending: Pendulum continues its violent swinging, leaving an onion-skin motion blur trail behind it.

title: Alternating Polarity (The Drop)
environment: A stylized, glowing track in an abstract sky.
transition: The pendulum zooms in to fill the screen, transitioning to the rollercoaster.
props: A simple vector rollercoaster cart.
beginning: The cart slowly creeps horizontally over the crest of a massive, glowing yellow peak (Mania).
climax: The cart tips over the edge and plummets straight down a 90-degree vertical drop into a pitch-black abyss (Depression).
ending: The cart disappears entirely into the dark void at the bottom of the screen.
colors: Peak glowing yellow (#FDE047). Abyss dark blue/black (#020617).

title: The Misdiagnosis
environment: A sterile doctor's office setting with a floor made of cracked glass.
props: Stickman patient, a doctor's hand holding out a pill.
beginning: Stickman stands nervously on the cracked glass floor.
climax: A doctor's hand enters from the left edge, holding a single, glowing blue capsule (SSRI) out to the stickman.
ending: The stickman reaches out to take the pill.

title: Gasoline on a Spark
transition: Snap-zoom in on the blue pill.
props: The blue pill, a tiny glowing red ember.
beginning: The blue pill falls through the air in slow motion toward a tiny, almost dead red ember on the floor.
climax: The pill hits the ember. Instead of extinguishing it, the impact triggers a massive, screen-filling explosion of red, orange, and yellow vector flames.
ending: The flames rage wildly, completely consuming the entire frame.

title: Rapid Cycling
transition: The flames clear via a radial wipe.
props: A mechanical dial gauge spanning from blue (Depression) to red (Mania).
beginning: The needle rests in the blue.
climax: The dial goes completely haywire, spinning rapidly back and forth between extreme blue and extreme red in erratic, unpredictable spasms.
ending: The needle vibrates violently as the glass on the gauge shatters.
colors: Left zone blue (#2563EB), Right zone red (#EF4444).

title: Title - SAD
props: Large typography, a dark snowflake icon.
beginning: Blank screen.
climax: Text "4. SEASONAL AFFECTIVE DISORDER (SAD)" appears. A heavy dark blue snowflake drops from the top and lands heavily next to the text.
ending: The text and snowflake hold steady.
colors: Text stark black, snowflake dark blue (#1E3A8A).

title: Circadian Collapse
props: A glowing brass pocket watch (representing the biological clock).
beginning: The inner gears of the watch are spinning smoothly.
climax: Sharp, jagged blue ice crystals suddenly grow rapidly from the edges of the screen inward, encasing the pocket watch completely.
ending: The gears inside violently grind to a dead halt, frozen solid inside the ice block.

title: The Suprachiasmatic Nucleus
environment: Diagrammatic cross-section of a human head.
transition: The ice shatters, transitioning to the diagram.
props: Outline of a brain, a glowing node (the SCN), and a sun icon.
beginning: A small node deep in the brain is dim.
climax: A bright yellow sun icon in the top corner shoots straight, golden laser-like beams into the brain node. The node greedily absorbs the light and glows brightly like a fully charged solar panel.
ending: The node pulses happily while receiving the sunlight.
colors: Light beams and node glow bright yellow (#FDE047).

title: Photoperiod Dependency
transition: The sun icon clicks off like a light switch, plunging into darkness.
props: Stickman sitting, a digital battery meter on his chest.
beginning: Stickman sits in total darkness. A green battery meter on his chest is rapidly depleting.
climax: The battery hits 0% and turns a dead, lifeless grey. The stickman slumps forward.
ending: Stickman remains motionless in the dark.

title: Spring Remission
props: Stickman, a beam of sunlight.
beginning: Stickman is slumped over.
climax: A sharp, intense beam of yellow sunlight violently punches through the dark ceiling like a physical pillar. It strikes the stickman.
ending: The stickman's chest battery instantly flashes to 100% bright green, and he sits upright immediately.

title: Title - Atypical Depression
transition: The yellow sunbeam expands to fill the screen white.
props: Large typography, a massive pie chart.
beginning: Text "5. ATYPICAL DEPRESSION" appears.
climax: A pie chart animates in, where the "Atypical" slice violently overrides the rest of the chart, taking up a dominant 80% portion in a bold color.
ending: The giant slice pulses once to emphasize its commonality.

title: Reversed Vegetative Signs
transition: The pie chart splits down the middle.
props: Stickman, plate of normal food, massive pile of junk food.
beginning: Left side (Classic): Stickman stares at a small plate of food and pushes it away in disgust.
climax: Right side (Atypical): A massive pile of donuts, burgers, and pastries drops onto the table. The stickman ravenously pulls the entire pile toward himself.
ending: The left side remains starved; the right side is consumed by hyperphagia.
colors: Junk food array uses bright, saturated colors.

title: Hypersomnia
props: Stickman in bed, a wall clock, a heavy iron anvil.
beginning: Stickman is asleep. The hands on the wall clock spin wildly, simulating 12 hours passing in 2 seconds.
climax: The stickman wakes up and sits up in bed. Instantly, a massive iron anvil icon drops and hovers directly over his head, pressing him back down.
ending: Stickman slumps back down under the weight of the anvil.

title: Leaden Paralysis
props: An X-ray view of a standing stickman.
beginning: Stickman stands normally.
climax: The bones in his arms and legs morph seamlessly into heavy, dark grey, solid lead pipes.
ending: The lead pipes extend downward, heavy and anchored directly into the floorboards, rendering him immobile.

title: Mood Reactivity (The False Hope)
props: Stickman, a heavy dark rain cloud, a tiny brightly wrapped gift box.
beginning: Stickman stands under a persistent dark rain cloud pouring grey lines.
climax: A brightly wrapped gift box falls from the sky into his hands. He opens it, and a warm, glowing yellow aura surrounds him, physically pushing the dark rain cloud away.
ending: He smiles temporarily, bathed in the yellow light.
colors: Rain cloud dark grey (#334155). Aura warm yellow (#FDE047).

title: The Crushing Return
props: Stickman, yellow aura, rain cloud, 1-ton weight.
beginning: Stickman is smiling in the yellow aura.
climax: A massive, cartoonish 1-TON iron weight drops violently from off-screen, instantly flattening the yellow aura out of existence.
ending: The dark rain cloud aggressively snaps back into position directly over his head, pouring harder than before.

title: PATTERN INTERRUPT (Stop)
props: A giant red "STOP" octagon.
beginning: The giant red stop sign slams into the direct center of the camera.
climax: The entire background instantly, violently shifts from a bright, clinical white to a dark, ominous navy blue. The screen shakes once on impact.
ending: The stop sign holds dead center on the dark background.
colors: Stop sign red (#DC2626). Background shifts to Navy Blue (#0F172A).

title: Rewire Your Thinking
transition: The stop sign scales down and disappears.
props: A thick brick wall labeled "REALITY".
beginning: A solid, impenetrable brick wall fills the screen.
climax: The wall violently shatters outward in slow motion. Behind the broken bricks, a swirling, chaotic, neon purple vortex is revealed.
ending: The broken bricks float in zero gravity as the purple vortex spins ominously in the background.

title: Title - Psychotic Depression
transition: The purple vortex from the previous scene flashes white and clears.
props: Large typography, a shattered mirror.
beginning: Text "6. PSYCHOTIC DEPRESSION" types onto the screen.
climax: A large vector mirror drops into the center of the frame and instantly shatters. The text reflects in the jagged shards, highly distorted and fragmented.
ending: The fragmented text holds steady in the broken glass.
colors: Text stark white. Background Navy Blue (#0F172A).

title: Reality Testing Shattered
transition: Zoom straight into one of the mirror shards.
props: Stickman, a terrifying reflection.
beginning: Stickman looks directly into a wall mirror.
climax: The reflection looking back is
ending: The monster reflection raises a clawed finger and points back at the stickman.
colors: Monster shadow pitch black (#000000). Eyes glowing red (#DC2626).

title: Delusions & Hallucinations
environment: Infographic flowchart space on a dark background.
props: Flowchart boxes and connecting lines.
beginning: A clean, glowing white box labeled "DEPRESSION" connects downward to "DESPAIR".
climax: A secondary path violently fractures off the main line. It forcefully draws a jagged, erratic red path leading to a new, aggressively shaking box labeled "HALLUCINATIONS".
ending: The "HALLUCINATIONS" box pulses with a harsh neon glow.
colors: Main boxes white. Hallucinations box glowing neon red (#EF4444).

title: Mood-Congruent Voices
environment: A pitch-black room illuminated by a single overhead spotlight.
props: Stickman crouching in the light, floating text bubbles.
beginning: Stickman cowers in the center spotlight, covering his ears.
climax: Sharp, jagged speech bubbles violently pop into existence in the dark space surrounding him, crowding him in.
ending: The bubbles aggressively bump into the spotlight, boxing the stickman in.
colors: Text reads: "FAILURE", "WORTHLESS", "RUINED" in bold black on stark white bubbles.

title: Cotard's Syndrome
props: X-ray view of the stickman's torso.
beginning: X-ray shows a healthy, pulsing vector heart and clean lungs.
climax: Stickman looks down at his chest in horror as the clean organs dissolve and melt into bubbling, toxic green sludge, dripping down into his stomach.
ending: The organs remain a pile of bubbling green liquid as an "ERROR" sign flashes.

title: Title - Postpartum Depression
transition: Sludge drips down, transitioning the screen.
props: Large typography, a baby pacifier icon.
beginning: Text "7. POSTPARTUM DEPRESSION" appears abruptly.
climax: A clean, cute pink pacifier icon sits next to the text. Suddenly, thick, dark, thorny vines snake out from the edges of the screen and tightly wrap around the pacifier, crushing it.
ending: The thorny vines hold the pacifier hostage.

title: Endocrine Collapse
environment: Clean infographic line graph on a dark background.
props: Line graph with two tracking lines.
beginning: Two steady, elevated lines (labeled "ESTROGEN" and "PROGESTERONE") track horizontally across the top of the chart.
climax: Both lines hit an invisible wall and instantly plummet at a 90-degree angle, dropping straight off the bottom of the screen.
ending: The chart remains empty and blank where the hormones used to be.
colors: Estrogen line pink (#EC4899), Progesterone line yellow (#FDE047).

title: System Failure
props: A wooden rack holding glowing pink and yellow test tubes.
beginning: The test tubes are glowing safely in the rack.
climax: An invisible force swings through, violently shattering all the test tubes at once. Glowing liquid violently splashes across the dark background.
ending: A giant, flashing red "SYSTEM FAILURE" alert overlays the spilled liquid.

title: Not Just "Baby Blues"
props: A balanced scale, a soft feather, a massive anvil.
beginning: A scale sits perfectly balanced. A small, soft blue feather labeled "Baby Blues" gently lands on the left pan. The pan barely registers the weight.
climax: A massive, black iron anvil labeled "PPD" drops from the sky onto the right pan.
ending: The anvil completely obliterates the right side of the scale, shattering the structural arm.

title: Title - PMDD
props: Large typography, a wall calendar.
beginning: Text "8. PREMENSTRUAL DYSPHORIC DISORDER (PMDD)" appears.
climax: A wall calendar drops in. Yellow biohazard symbols rapidly stamp themselves across a specific block of days.
ending: The biohazard stamps pulse ominously.

title: The Luteal Phase Switch
props: Calendar week view, a heavy industrial lever.
beginning: The calendar shows a 7-day span. A heavy metal lever is mounted next to it in the "OFF" position.
climax: A skeletal hand violently pulls the heavy lever down into the "ON" position.
ending: The 7-day span instantly illuminates with an aggressive, glowing red border.

title: The Triple Threat
props: Stickman, a black rain cloud, a roaring fireball, jagged lightning bolts.
beginning: Stickman falls to his knees in the center of the frame.
climax: Three aggressive avatars instantly surround him: A heavy black rain cloud (Depression), a roaring vector fireball (Anger), and sharp, jagged lightning bolts (Anxiety) striking the ground around him.
ending: The stickman covers his head, completely trapped in the chaotic storm.

title: Neurological Vulnerability
props: A brain icon, a gentle wave of blue liquid.
beginning: A healthy pink brain icon sits on the right. A small, gentle wave of blue liquid (representing normal hormone shifts) floats toward it from the left.
climax: The completely normal blue wave touches the brain. Instantly, the brain violently short-circuits, sparking electricity and turning dark, bruised purple.
ending: The brain smokes, heavily damaged by a completely normal interaction.
colors: Liquid blue (#3B82F6). Damaged brain bruised purple (#6B21A8).

title: The Reset
transition: Fast zoom out back to the calendar.
props: Calendar, a single drop of blood.
beginning: The calendar is glowing red, surrounded by the chaos of fire and lightning from Scene 48 in the background.
climax: A single, clean vector drop of red blood falls and lands on the calendar grid.
ending: Instantly, all the storm clouds, fire, and lightning completely vanish into thin air. The red border disappears, returning to a peaceful, calm white calendar.

title: Title - DMDD
props: Large typography, a child-sized stickman.
beginning: Text "9. DISRUPTIVE MOOD DYSREGULATION DISORDER (DMDD)" appears.
climax: A child-sized stickman stands next to the text. Heavy, intense red heat waves actively radiate off his body in a continuous loop.
ending: The child stickman stands rigid, vibrating slightly with tension.

title: Adult vs. Child Withdrawal
props: Adult stickman, child stickman, heavy grey box.
beginning: Left side: An adult stickman curls into a fetal ball and covers himself with a heavy, solid grey box to hide.
climax: Right side: The child stickman does the exact opposite. He violently kicks a massive hole straight through a matching grey box, screaming.
ending: The child stands in the wreckage of the box, surrounded by aggressive, spiky red action lines.

title: Masking Despair
props: X-ray overlay.
beginning: The child stickman is glowing angry red.
climax: A blue X-ray scanning beam passes over the child. Inside the angry red exterior, the X-ray reveals a deeply sad, crying, dark blue face hiding in the chest cavity.
ending: The X-ray remains active, showing the profound sadness trapped inside the rage.
colors: Outer shell Red (#EF4444). Inner face Blue (#1D4ED8).

title: Temper Outbursts
environment: A weekly planner graphic on a clean desk.
props: Weekly planner (Monday-Sunday grid).
beginning: The planner shows a normal week.
climax: Monday, Wednesday, and Friday squares suddenly bulge outward and violently explode, replaced by cartoonish, black round bomb icons with lit fuses.
ending: The bombs smoke on the ruined planner.

title: Not Bad Behavior
props: A piece of paper, a medical clipboard.
beginning: A piece of lined paper labeled "Naughty List" sits in the center.
climax: A heavy, solid metal medical clipboard slams down directly on top of it, ripping the "Naughty List" cleanly in half.
ending: The medical clipboard displays a jagged, highly erratic brainwave line, confirming a neurological disorder.

title: Title - TRD
props: Large typography, a prescription pill bottle.
beginning: Text "10. TREATMENT-RESISTANT DEPRESSION (TRD)" appears.
climax: A standard orange prescription pill bottle sits next to it. Heavy, dark iron chains whip around the bottle and snap together with a massive, heavy padlock.
ending: The pill bottle remains completely locked up and inaccessible.

title: Pharmacological Non-Responsiveness
props: A massive stone fortress wall, tiny medical pills.
beginning: A towering, impenetrable stone fortress wall labeled "DEPRESSION" completely blocks the screen.
climax: Hundreds of tiny medical pills and syringes fly at the wall like a barrage of arrows. They all hit the stone and bounce off completely harmlessly, doing zero damage.
ending: The pills lay scattered on the ground. The wall stands perfectly intact.

title: Receptor Block
transition: Zoom-in on the wall, dissolving into the cells.
props: U-shaped receptors, pills, a glowing forcefield.
beginning: Three green pills float downward toward U-shaped brain receptors at the bottom of the screen.
climax: Just before they connect, an invisible blue forcefield activates across the top of the receptors. The green pills hit it and are violently violently rejected, bouncing back to the top of the screen.
ending: The forcefield pulses brightly, keeping the receptors totally empty.

title: The Two Trials
environment: Infographic flowchart on a clean white background.
props: Flowchart logic boxes.
beginning: A box labeled "TRIAL 1 (SSRI)" attempts a connection down the flowchart.
climax: The path hits a giant RED X. A second box labeled "TRIAL 2 (SNRI)" attempts a connection. It also hits a giant RED X. Both failed paths converge downward into a massive, heavy black box labeled "TRD".
ending: The "TRD" box locks into place with a heavy metallic sound effect implied by screen shake.
colors: Fail X's red (#DC2626). TRD box solid black.

title: Drastic Alternative Interventions
props: Stickman, a tray of pills, a glowing TMS machine.
beginning: Stickman sits in a chair. A tray of standard pills is offered to him.
climax: He aggressively pushes the tray of pills away. Instantly, a massive, high-tech, glowing medical device (resembling a Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation helmet) descends from the ceiling and locks into place over his head.
ending: The machine powers up, glowing with intense, pulsating blue magnetic rings.

title: Not a Choice
props: Stickman, a multiple-choice test, a ghostly hand.
beginning: Stickman stands at a desk holding a pencil, hovering over a test paper. Box A reads "HAPPY", Box B reads "DEPRESSED". He tries to move his pencil to Box A.
climax: A giant, invisible ghostly hand appears, wraps forcefully around the stickman's hand, and violently forces the pencil to fill in Box B (DEPRESSED) against his will.
ending: The stickman's arm remains locked in place by the ghostly hand.

title: Mechanical Failure
props: Futuristic computer terminal displaying a human wireframe.
beginning: A green, healthy wireframe of a human is displayed on a monitor.
climax: The screen glitches violently. The wireframe turns stark red as lines of chaotic, corrupted binary code pour down the screen.
ending: A massive, solid red banner slams across the center of the screen reading "SYSTEM FAILURE".

title: The Abrupt End
props: Glitching terminal.
beginning: Screen is displaying the red "SYSTEM FAILURE".
climax: Exactly on the final syllable of the voiceover ("...system"), the screen behaves like an old CRT television being unplugged. The image snaps into a single bright horizontal white line, then instantly shrinks into a tiny dot and vanishes.
ending: True, pitch black.
